_meta.instructions: Replace <YOUR_USERNAME> with the Apify Actor owner's username and <YOUR_APIFY_API_TOKEN> with your personal Apify API token from https://console.apify.com/settings/integrations.

actorStandbyDirectEndpoint.description: Direct connection to the Actor Standby /mcp Streamable HTTP endpoint exposing the `audit_website_accessibility` tool with sub-second warm startup.

claudeCodeCli.command: claude mcp add --transport http wcag-eaa-ada-auditor "https://mcp.apify.com/?tools=<YOUR_USERNAME>/wcag-eaa-ada-auditor" --header "Authorization: Bearer <YOUR_APIFY_API_TOKEN>"

sampleAgentPrompts.prompt: Call audit_website_accessibility on https://staging.example.eu with wcagLevel='AA', includeVisualEvidence=true, detectOverlays=true, and checkAccessibilityStatement=true. Then locate the matching components in my local repository and apply the ARIA/HTML fixes.

Audit https://prospect-store.com using the WCAG EAA ADA Auditor MCP tool. Summarize their legalRiskScore, check whether they rely on an overlay like accessiBe or UserWay, give me the annotated visualEvidenceUrl, and draft a concise technical remediation proposal.
